provenance.input_scope: Synthetic native ObjectStroke setter calls, not serialized SDocx parser input. Color setter is omitted in every case; the wrapper additionally calls native ObjectStroke::GetColor and records Pen::GetSize after Drawing plus PenDrawableRT::SetPenData arguments. In-memory patches alter only the input row, selected size/tool setter calls, fixed-count/source-getter checks, and output metadata.
provenance.runtime_scope: Pinned native Model getters, Drawing caller, DefaultPen drawable and RT AddPoint execute under Unicorn. IContext is a synthetic 1920x1080 host profile; canvas/task queue, identity color conversion and graphics services are bounded host adapters.
